new.angle: U0408 #10; PYQ y9bdbe5ac061 PCR inadequacy -> PoA angle (other direction)

new.s: In Safai Karamchari Andolan v Union of India (2014), what compensation did the Supreme Court fix for each sewer death since 1993?
new.x: The 2014 judgment fixed ₹10 lakh per sewer death since 1993; Balram Singh (2023) raised it to ₹30 lakh.
new.angle: U0408 #8 Safai Karamchari Andolan case

new.s: On which date did the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 receive the President's assent?
new.x: The PoA Act got assent on 11 September 1989 and came into force on 30 January 1990.
new.angle: U0408 #3/#10 PoA Act commencement (notes gap)

new.s: Which Section of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act bars the release of a convict on probation?
new.x: Section 19 bars probation; Section 18 bars anticipatory bail, 18A removes preliminary enquiry and Section 23 gives rule-making power.
new.angle: U0408 #3/#12 PoA sections -> content (notes gap)
